Codes are current as of Mar. 2022 / 236 release.

| Code | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | NOT UPDATED |
| 1 | ALIVE |
| 2 | SHUTTING DOWN |
| 3 | LB OFFLINE |
| 4 | SPINMODE |
| 5 | DCP WAITING FOR PERMITS |
| 6 | BIG RED BUTTON |
| 7 | ALL RAC NODE DOWN PAUSE |
| 8 | SR POD |
| 9 | SERVER BUSY PATTERN |
| 10 | BUSY JVM WARM UP |
| 11 | BUSY APEX WARM UP |
| 12 | BUSY CENTRIFUGE WARM UP |
| 20 | BUSY HIGH CPU |
| 21 | BUSY HIGH GC |
| 22 | BUSY DISK FULL |
| 23 | BUSY DB CONN POOL BUSY |
| 24 | BUSY LOGGING QUEUE FULL |
| 25 | BUSY FFX SERVER WAIT TIME |
| 26 | BUSY CLOSED BY INTERRUPT EXCEPTION |
| 27 | THREAD POOL SATURATION |
| 30 | BUSY UNKNOWN REASON |

panels.description: Percentage of CPU requested CPU used per minute. Note that it's possible for containers to use greater than 100% of CPU request/quota and throttling is not guaranteed to occur unless the *limit* is exceeded.

builder.query:
WITH
  kube_state_hourly AS (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('hour', kube_state_raw."__time") AS "__time",
      kube_state_raw.k8s_pod_name,
      kube_state_raw.k8s_container_name,
      kube_state_raw.falcon_instance,
      kube_state_raw.functional_domain_instance,
      MAX(
        CAST(
          JSON_VALUE(
            kube_state_raw.kube_pod_container_resource_requests,
            '$.cpu.core'
          ) AS DOUBLE
        )
      ) AS container_cpu_cores_request,
      MAX(
        CAST(
          JSON_VALUE(
            kube_state_raw.kube_pod_container_resource_requests,
            '$.memory.byte'
          ) AS DOUBLE
        )
      ) AS container_memory_bytes_request,
      MAX(
        CAST(
          JSON_VALUE(
            kube_state_raw.kube_pod_container_resource_limits,
            '$.cpu.core'
          ) AS DOUBLE
        )
      ) AS container_cpu_cores_limit,
      MAX(
        CAST(
          JSON_VALUE(
            kube_state_raw.kube_pod_container_resource_limits,
            '$.memory.byte'
          ) AS DOUBLE
        )
      ) AS container_memory_bytes_limit
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          __time,
          k8s_pod_name,
          k8s_container_name,
          falcon_instance,
          functional_domain_instance,
          kube_pod_container_resource_limits,
          kube_pod_container_resource_requests
        FROM
          KubeState
        WHERE
          __time >= TIME_SHIFT(MILLIS_TO_TIMESTAMP(${__from}), 'pt10m', -1)
          AND __time <= MILLIS_TO_TIMESTAMP(${__to})
          AND k8s_container_name = 'coreapp'
          AND falcon_instance = '$fi'
          AND functional_domain_instance = '$fd'
          AND k8s_pod_name LIKE '$cell-casam-app%'
      ) AS kube_state_raw
    GROUP BY
      1,
      2,
      3,
      4,
      5
  ),
  cadvisor_metrics AS (
    SELECT
      __time,
      previous_timestamp,
      k8s_pod_name,
      k8s_container_name,
      falcon_instance,
      functional_domain_instance,
      instance_type,
      zone,
      timestamp_seconds_diff,
      cpu_seconds_diff,
      cfs_throttled_seconds_diff,
      cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_diff,
      cpu_cfs_periods_diff,
      oom_events_diff,
      memory_usage_bytes,
      device,
      sockets,
      file_descriptors
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          -- Propagate up raw metrics.
          *,
          -- Elapsed seconds between metrics.
          (CAST(TIMESTAMPDIFF (MILLISECOND, previous_timestamp, __time) AS DOUBLE) / 1000) AS timestamp_seconds_diff,
          (
            cpu_usage_seconds_total - previous_cpu_usage_seconds_total
          ) AS cpu_seconds_diff,
          -- Elapsed CFS throttled seconds.
          (
            cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total - previous_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total
          ) AS cfs_throttled_seconds_diff,
          -- Elapsed CFS periods. (Total, not throttled.)
          (
            cpu_cfs_periods_total - previous_cpu_cfs_periods_total
          ) AS cpu_cfs_periods_diff,
          -- Throttled CFS periods.
          (
            cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total - previous_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total
          ) AS cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_diff,
          -- OOM events.
          (
            oom_events_total - previous_oom_events_total
          ) AS oom_events_diff
        FROM
          (
            SELECT
              *,
              LAG("__time", 1, "__time") OVER w AS previous_timestamp,
              LAG(
                cpu_usage_seconds_total,
                1,
                cpu_usage_seconds_total
              ) OVER w AS previous_cpu_usage_seconds_total,
              LAG(
                cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total,
                1,
                cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total
              ) OVER w AS previous_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total,
              LAG (
                cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total,
                1,
                cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total
              ) OVER w AS previous_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total,
              LAG(
                cpu_cfs_periods_total,
                1,
                cpu_cfs_periods_total
              ) OVER w AS previous_cpu_cfs_periods_total,
              LAG(
                oom_events_total,
                1,
                oom_events_total
              ) OVER w AS previous_oom_events_total
            FROM
              (
                SELECT
                  "__time",
                  k8s_pod_name,
                  k8s_container_name,
                  falcon_instance,
                  functional_domain_instance,
                  instance_type,
                  zone,
                  device,
                  container_cpu_cfs_periods_total AS cpu_cfs_periods_total,
                  container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total AS cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total,
                  container_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total AS cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total,
                  container_cpu_usage_seconds_total AS "cpu_usage_seconds_total",
                  container_file_descriptors AS file_descriptors,
                  container_sockets AS sockets,
                  container_oom_events_total AS oom_events_total,
                  container_memory_usage_bytes AS memory_usage_bytes
                FROM
                  cAdvisor
                WHERE
                  __time >= TIME_SHIFT(MILLIS_TO_TIMESTAMP(${__from}), 'pt10m', -1)
                  AND __time <= MILLIS_TO_TIMESTAMP(${__to})
                  AND k8s_container_name = 'coreapp'
                  AND falcon_instance = '$fi'
                  AND functional_domain_instance = '$fd'
                  AND k8s_pod_name LIKE '$cell-casam-app-%'
              )
            WINDOW
              w AS (
                PARTITION BY
                  falcon_instance,
                  functional_domain_instance,
                  k8s_pod_name,
                  k8s_container_name,
                  instance_type,
                  zone,
                  device
                ORDER BY
                  "__time" ASC
              )
          )
      )
  )
SELECT
  --time_floor(cadvisor_metrics.__time, 'pt12h') AS "timestamp",
  time_floor(cadvisor_metrics.__time, 'pt$interval') AS "timestamp",
  cadvisor_metrics.k8s_pod_name,
  cadvisor_metrics.k8s_container_name,
  cadvisor_metrics.falcon_instance,
  cadvisor_metrics.functional_domain_instance AS functional_domain,
  cadvisor_metrics.instance_type,
  cadvisor_metrics.zone,
  cadvisor_metrics.device,
  AVG(GREATEST(timestamp_seconds_diff, 0)) AS seconds_from_previous_cadvisor_metric,
  MAX(container_cpu_cores_request) AS container_cpu_cores_request,
  MAX(container_cpu_cores_limit) AS container_cpu_cores_limit,
  AVG(GREATEST(((cpu_seconds_diff / timestamp_seconds_diff / container_cpu_cores_request) * 100), 0)) AS "CPU Quota Usage",
  AVG(GREATEST(((cpu_seconds_diff / timestamp_seconds_diff / container_cpu_cores_limit) * 100), 0)) AS cpu_pct_limit_utilization,
  MAX(memory_usage_bytes) AS memory_usage_bytes,
  MAX(container_memory_bytes_request) AS container_memory_bytes_request,
  MAX(container_memory_bytes_limit) AS container_memory_bytes_limit,

                  functional_domain_instance,
                  instance_type,
                  zone,
                  device,
                  container_cpu_cfs_periods_total AS cpu_cfs_periods_total,
                  container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total AS cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total,
                  container_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total AS cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total,
                  container_cpu_usage_seconds_total AS "cpu_usage_seconds_total",
                  container_file_descriptors AS file_descriptors,
                  container_sockets AS sockets,
                  container_oom_events_total AS oom_events_total,
                  container_memory_usage_bytes AS memory_usage_bytes
                FROM
                  cAdvisor
                WHERE
                  __time >= TIME_SHIFT(MILLIS_TO_TIMESTAMP(${__from}), 'pt10m', -1)
                  AND __time <= MILLIS_TO_TIMESTAMP(${__to})
                  AND k8s_container_name NOT IN ('coreapp', 'madkub-refresher', 'keymaker-client-refresher')
                  AND falcon_instance = '$fi'
                  AND functional_domain_instance = '$fd'
                  AND k8s_pod_name LIKE '$cell-casam-app%'
              )
            WINDOW
              w AS (
                PARTITION BY
                  falcon_instance,
                  functional_domain_instance,
                  k8s_pod_name,
                  k8s_container_name,
                  instance_type,
                  zone,
                  device
                ORDER BY
                  "__time" ASC
              )
            LIMIT 10000000
          )
      )
  )
SELECT
  --time_floor(cadvisor_metrics.__time, 'pt12h') AS "timestamp",
  time_floor(cadvisor_metrics.__time, 'pt$interval') AS "timestamp",
  cadvisor_metrics.k8s_pod_name,
  cadvisor_metrics.k8s_container_name,
  cadvisor_metrics.falcon_instance,
  cadvisor_metrics.functional_domain_instance AS functional_domain,
  cadvisor_metrics.instance_type,
  cadvisor_metrics.zone,
  cadvisor_metrics.device,
  AVG(GREATEST(timestamp_seconds_diff, 0)) AS seconds_from_previous_cadvisor_metric,
  MAX(container_cpu_cores_request) AS container_cpu_cores_request,
  MAX(container_cpu_cores_limit) AS container_cpu_cores_limit,
  AVG(GREATEST(((cpu_seconds_diff / timestamp_seconds_diff / container_cpu_cores_request) * 100), 0)) AS "CPU Quota Usage",
  AVG(GREATEST(((cpu_seconds_diff / timestamp_seconds_diff / container_cpu_cores_limit) * 100), 0)) AS cpu_pct_limit_utilization,
  MAX(memory_usage_bytes) AS memory_usage_bytes,
  MAX(container_memory_bytes_request) AS container_memory_bytes_request,
  MAX(container_memory_bytes_limit) AS container_memory_bytes_limit,
  MAX(((memory_usage_bytes / container_memory_bytes_request) * 100)) AS container_memory_pct_request_utilization,
  MAX(((memory_usage_bytes / container_memory_bytes_limit) * 100)) AS container_memory_pct_limit_utilization,
  SUM(GREATEST(oom_events_diff, 0)) AS oom_events_diff,
  AVG(GREATEST(cfs_throttled_seconds_diff, 0)/(timestamp_seconds_diff/60)) AS cfs_throttled_seconds_per_minute,
  AVG(GREATEST(cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_diff, 0)) AS cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_diff,
  AVG(GREATEST(cpu_cfs_periods_diff, 0)) AS cpu_cfs_periods_diff,
  AVG(((GREATEST(cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_diff, 0) / cpu_cfs_periods_diff) * 100)) AS cpu_cfs_pct_throttled_periods,
  AVG(sockets) AS sockets,
  AVG(file_descriptors) AS file_descriptors
FROM
  cadvisor_metrics
  LEFT JOIN kube_state_hourly ON (
    cadvisor_metrics.falcon_instance = kube_state_hourly.falcon_instance
    AND cadvisor_metrics.functional_domain_instance = kube_state_hourly.functional_domain_instance
    AND cadvisor_metrics.k8s_pod_name = kube_state_hourly.k8s_pod_name
    AND cadvisor_metrics.k8s_container_name = kube_state_hourly.k8s_container_name
    AND DATE_TRUNC('day', cadvisor_metrics.__time) = kube_state_hourly.__time
  )
GROUP BY
  1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8
--LIMIT 1000000","intervals":{"type":"intervals","intervals":["${__from:date:iso}/${__to:date:iso}"]}},"settings":{}}

options.content:
This section shows metrics derived from 
org-specific metrics on the target instance. 
Metrics for orgs that have purchased Signature
(SIG/MCS) or Proactive Monitoring (ProM) 
are displayed here as well as other orgs, 
primarily SFDC-owned orgs, that have metrics
enabled. Note there is not a good way to 
distinguish between the different types 
of orgs on this dashboard.

panels.description: Number of requests completing per second by org.
panels.title: Request Rate (count / second)

panels.description: APT (server-side response time) broken down by org.

targets.rawSql:
DOWNSAMPLE(
  GROUPBY(
    GROUPBY(
      CULL_BELOW(
        RATE(
          $start:$end:core.$substrate.$fi.$fd:SFDC_type-OrgSpecificMetrics-???????????????.LogMetric-WALL_TIME{cell=$cell,k8s_pod_name=*}:avg:1m-avg
        ),
        #0#,#value#
      ),
      #SFDC_type-OrgSpecificMetrics-(\S{15}).LogMetric-WALL_TIME#,#sum#,#union#
    ),
    GROUPBY(
      CULL_BELOW(
        RATE(
          $start:$end:core.$substrate.$fi.$fd:SFDC_type-OrgSpecificMetrics-???????????????.LogMetric-COUNT{cell=$cell,k8s_pod_name=*}:avg:1m-avg
        ),
        #0#,#value#
      ),
      #SFDC_type-OrgSpecificMetrics-(\S{15}).LogMetric-COUNT#,#sum#,#union#
    )
  ,#(\S{15})#,#divide#,#union#,#0#)
,#$interval-$agg#)
